script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'worktree-probe',
  description: 'Probe whether worktree isolation works in this repo',
  phases: [{ title: 'Probe', detail: 'one agent checks its cwd and git state' }],
}
phase('Probe')
const r = await agent(
  `Run these shell commands and report the raw output verbatim:\n` +
  `1. pwd\n2. git rev-parse --show-toplevel\n3. git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD\n4. git status --short | head\n` +
  `Then create a file named PROBE.txt containing the text "probe" at the repo root of your current working directory, ` +
  `then run: git add -A && git diff --cached --stat\n` +
  `Then write the patch: git add -A && git diff --cached --binary > /tmp/wfp/__probe.patch ; then run: wc -c /tmp/wfp/__probe.patch\n` +
  `Report all outputs.`,
  { label: 'probe', isolation: 'worktree' }
)
log('probe done')
return r
result:
1. `pwd`
```
/workspace/.claude/worktrees/wf_1051d96b-5ca-1
```

2. `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`
```
/workspace/.claude/worktrees/wf_1051d96b-5ca-1
```

3. `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`
```
worktree-wf_1051d96b-5ca-1
```

4. `git status --short | head`
```
(empty output)
```

Created `/workspace/.claude/worktrees/wf_1051d96b-5ca-1/PROBE.txt` containing `probe`.

5. `git add -A && git diff --cached --stat`
```
 PROBE.txt | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
```

6. `git add -A && git diff --cached --binary > /tmp/wfp/__probe.patch ; wc -c /tmp/wfp/__probe.patch`
```
130 /tmp/wfp/__probe.patch
```

Note: `/tmp/wfp` did not exist, so `mkdir -p /tmp/wfp` was run first in the same command to allow the redirect to succeed.
